feature: PLUS court reduction: hanya mengubah amount_payable tanpa TS-RED, plus revert-nya (POST /plus-apply-reduction-court dan /plus-revert-reduction-court)
note: Untuk notice di court stage, reduction dari PLUS hanya mengubah amount_payable di VON dan eVON tanpa suspension TS-RED, tanpa baris suspended_notice, dan tanpa baris reduced_offence_amount (ReductionPersistenceService.applyCourtReduction). Jadi notice ini tidak punya masa reduction yang menahan stage lewat suspension_type; perilaku blok escalation story 16.16/16.17 tidak berlaku untuknya. Belum jelas story mana yang menaungi fitur ini.
note_en: For court-stage notices, a PLUS reduction only changes amount_payable on VON and eVON, with no TS-RED suspension, no suspended_notice row and no reduced_offence_amount row (ReductionPersistenceService.applyCourtReduction). So these notices have no reduction period that holds the stage through suspension_type; the escalation block of stories 16.16/16.17 does not apply to them. It is unclear which story covers this feature.
